## LO-04 Weekly Audit (spec §6, §10 WF04)
Sunday 20:00 America/Vancouver, or `POST /lo/audit/run {user_id?, week_start?, invest?}`.
Per user: spend per category → under/over (no netting) → cushion → late-posting true-up → carries and cap → audit row → LO-05 invests → LO-07 digest.
Data Tables are read first (Code nodes can't read them); all math is one Code node with `lib/audit.mjs` pasted verbatim and an inline §6.8 self-test.
**Idempotent:** one audit per `audit_id = user_id-week_start`; a rerun writes nothing and never invests twice. `invest:false` = backfill (no LO-05, no digest).

### Runs top to bottom
n8n v1 runs these branches one after another, top first: write rows → invest → digest → respond. Keep that vertical order if you move nodes.

### Sunday 20:00 schedule
Audits every active user (and records paused ones) for the current week, invests via LO-05, then sends the digest via LO-07. Enabled in Wave 3.
